abilities.name: Mire Pitchfork
abilities.text: Passive. Add +1 Grit against enemies in salvage, hazard, or mire sectors.

abilities.name: Compost Cape
abilities.text: Once per round, the first yellow hazard you face has -1 difficulty.

abilities.name: Yard King
abilities.text: Descriptive only. Popelord turns cleared salvage and hazard ground into a stronger local haul.

abilities.name: Ripe Warning
abilities.text: Descriptive only. Popelord warns arrivals about unresolved yellow blockers. Weakness: failed blue Anomaly tests remain especially dangerous.
